findings.impact: Historical audit's ten owned starter cards, 123 campaign tickets and seven-day income no longer describe current source. Current initial ownership is 24; campaign maximum is 219 tickets; additional recurring non-match sources materially change pacing.
findings.recommendation: Use current source-derived catalog and explicit claim cohorts; preserve frozen historical audit rather than editing it into a current baseline.

findings.impact: Production-eligible KYLE plus CITYLEGENDS grant 60000 Clout and 25 tickets once per account, equivalent to 300 single-pack gross Clout prices plus 25 tickets, before rebates. These dwarf organic weekly income.
findings.recommendation: Separate promo cohorts and review intended public availability; do not retrospectively remove grants.

findings.impact: Stockz stakes ordinary softCurrency without earned/purchased provenance. Randomized double-or-zero payout is not an economic faucet in expectation, but permits loss of any Clout in that wallet.
findings.recommendation: Have payment/policy owner evaluate shared paid-currency exposure; no claim of legal violation or actual player spending.

findings.impact: All 7/9/12-card milestones are immediately eligible with the 24-card foundation, independently of packs. Three card grants, 50 universal shards and 150 Clout are finite onboarding-adjacent rewards.
findings.recommendation: Model separately from random pack outcomes and review whether milestones still teach intended progression.

findings.impact: Duplicate payouts cannot be summed into universal cosmetic affordability. Rare-tier wallet balances cannot buy another tier's cosmetics, even when aggregate balance exceeds price.
findings.recommendation: Model each tier plus universal balance and matching-first spending; measure redemption by tier before tuning.

findings.impact: Pack retries reuse the original opening for the same key even if payment method/pull count changes, unlike shop's explicit fingerprint conflict. This avoids a second debit but can surprise a client.
findings.recommendation: Document immutable retry semantics or add parameter mismatch validation without invalidating historical receipts.

findings.impact: cosmeticCurrency is persisted/serialized but no current mutation or sink was located; treating it as active would invent an economy.
findings.recommendation: Label dormant and preserve old values; consider deprecation only in a separate compatibility review.

findings.impact: Stacked claim surfaces may reward return visits or create claim fatigue; source rules alone cannot establish either effect.
findings.recommendation: Use the existing collection-reward analytics follow-up rather than claiming retention improvements.
